about: The answers of the ctx MCP tools store, get and search that the ctx_checkpoint plugin parses (memory/mcp_client.py).
One source for both sides: go/internal/handler/mcp_checkpoint_answers_integration_test.go drives the real MCP handlers
with the write below and compares their answers with this file; memory/tests/test_mcp_answer_contract.py and
tests/test_paced_idempotent_chain.py feed exactly these answers to the plugin. A change on either side turns the other red.
